SPECIFICATION FOR 

RETRACTOR, ENDAURAL ( LEMPERTS PATTERN ) 


1. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements for endaural retractor Lempert's pattern used in ENT 
surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown In Fig. 1.

FIG. 1 RETRACTOR, ENDAURAL (LEMPERT'S PATTERN) 

3. Material — Stainless steel. Designation 22Crl3 or 30Crl3 of Schedule V of IS : 1570-1961 
' Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purposes V 


4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 All surfaces shall be smooth and free A^r surface flaws. 

4.2 All sharp edges shall be rounded. \ / 

4.3 The retracting arms shall not be loose at the pTVo^s.,--^- 

4.4 The retractor shall be passivated and finished dull. 

5. Heat Treatment—The retractor shall be hardened and tempered to a hardness of 400 to 500 HV. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test— Scrub the retractor with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and 
then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the retractor. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at room 
temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. 


The solution shall be made up as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CUSO 4 . 5 H 2 O ) 
Sulphuric acid ( H 2 SO 4 ) ( sp gr 1 84 ) 
Water ( H 2 O) 


4.0 g 

10 0 g 

90.0 ml

IS : 5747 - 1970 


No red stains or spots on the retractor shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

7. Marking — Each retractor shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer’s name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ’ stainless steel’. 

7.1 ISl Certification Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution . 

8. Packing—Each retractor shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or put in a polyethylene bag 
and shall then be packed in an individual cardboard carton, or the packing shall be done as agreed 
to between the purchaser and the supplier.
